violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION. ONLY EMPLOYEE WITH CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATION WAS EXPIRED.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CFM MUST BE ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' OBSERVED NO SIGNED COPIES ON SITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS WILL FORWARD COPY TO PIC, PLEASE REVIEW WITH EMPLOYEES AND HAVE EACH EMPLOYEE SIGN A COPY. MAINTAIN SIGNED COPIES ON SITE FOR REVEW BY THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: PRECOOKED CHICKEN AT 44F, PRECOOKED BONELESS WINGS AT 47F AND SAUSAGE AT 44F IN DELFIELD 2 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC TRANSFERRED FOODS TO OTHER REFRIGERATION UNITS FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold holding equipment: RANDELL 2 DOOR PREP TOP REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE CLOCK IN TO START SHIFT AND PROCEED TO OVEN TO REMOVE PIZZAS WITHOUT WASHING HANDS.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS BEFORE ENGAGING IN ANY FOOD PREPARATION ACTIVITIES AT THE BEGINNING OF SHIFT AND WHERE NECESSARY. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEE TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE RINSE HANDS AND DRIED WITH PAPER TOWELS WITHOUT APPLYING SOAP.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO APPLY SOAP TO WASH HANDS PROPERLY BEFORE RINSING AND DRYING. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEE TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF VARIOUS SAUCES - GARLIC PARMESAN, HONEY BBQ, RANCH, ETC, , STORED ABOVE PREP TOP WITHOUT LABELS.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO APPLY LABELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS IN SANITIZER SOLUTION AT 0 PPM IN 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCONNECTED SANITIZER SYSTEM TO MANUALLY ADJUST THE SANITIZER CONCENTRATION TO 200-400 PPM.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: OBSERVED SANITIZER SYSTEM NOT OPERATING PROPERLY TO DISPENSE SANITIZER AT ACCEPTABLE CONCENTRATIONS. QUATERNARY AMMONIUM TESTED 0 PPM.
violations.corrective_action: REPAIR SYSTEM TO DISPENSE SANITIZER BETWEEN 200-400 PPM. PIC WILL MANUALLY ADJUST AND TEST SANITIZER CONCENTRATION IN THE INTERIM. DOMINO'S #4389 (Inspection Date: 12/13/2024) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED COLD RAIL ABOVE 2 DOOR PREP TOP (LEFT) AT 47F, FOODS TEMPED 43-45F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS ADVISED PIC THAT TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL CAN BE ALSO USED UNTIL THE UNIT IS REPAIRED. FOODS MUST HAVE A START TEMPERATURE OF 41F AND BE MARKED AND DISCARDED AFTER 4 HOURS. PIC ADVISED FOODS WILL BE KEPT UNDER TEMPERATURE CONTROL. PLEASE ENSURE TCS FOODS ARE NOT STORED IN THE COLD RAIL SECTION UNTIL UNIT IS REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BEFORE NEXT INSPECTION.
